analyst.summary: LatentView Analytics is a data-analytics and AI consulting firm that has delivered consistent 21-23% revenue growth with healthy 20-22% margins and a net-cash balance sheet. Our quantitative score flags this as a Sell, largely because a large one-year jump in fixed assets (likely a facility investment funded from IPO cash) has temporarily depressed capital-efficiency metrics -- but the underlying growth and profitability are genuinely strong, and the ~32x earnings multiple is not demanding for that combination. We are moving this to Hold, while flagging a recent CEO transition and industry-wide GenAI pricing pressure on analytics services as risks to watch.
